claims.content: The Manager must be logged into the Auction Administration system.
The Manager must have access to the 'Auction Admin Main Menu Page' or a specific inventory management page (e.g., 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report').
Product inventory data must exist within the system database to be managed.
The Manager navigates to the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' page or a similar inventory management interface within the Auction Administration system.

claims.content: The system displays the updated inventory list reflecting any changes made (e.g., items marked as auction eligible or not).
The 'Auction Available' status for specific SKUs is updated based on the Manager's selections.
Summary statistics (SKU Count, SKU with no/unavailable location, Auction Available piece count, etc.) are recalculated and displayed accurately.
